parameters.name: precedence_rules
parameters.description: List of precedence or dependency rules

variables.name: child_selected
variables.description: Binary selection variable for child $i$, where 1 indicates the child is selected

constraints.name: selection_cardinality_bounds
constraints.description: The number of selected children must be between the minimum and maximum trip sizes.

constraints.name: mandatory_child_inclusion
constraints.description: Every mandatory child must be selected.

constraints.name: precedence_dependency_rules
constraints.description: If a child triggers a precedence rule, all listed dependent children must also be selected.

constraints.name: incompatibility_rules
constraints.description: If a child triggers an incompatibility rule, none of the listed forbidden children may be selected together with it.

constraints.name: binary_selection_variables
constraints.description: Each child selection decision is binary.

constraints.name: selection_cardinality_bounds_lower
constraints.description: The number of selected children must be at least the minimum trip size.

constraints.name: selection_cardinality_bounds_upper
constraints.description: The number of selected children must not exceed the maximum trip size.

objectives.name: minimize_total_selection_cost
objectives.description: Minimize the total selection cost of the chosen children.

final_objective.description: Minimize the total selection cost of the chosen children in the single-period child selection problem.
